verdict.rationale: Data residency and cross-border handling are a fair governance question for a KYC/fraud-decisioning SaaS like Alloy, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a contracted processing region, data-residency options or cross-border transfer handling. The sandbox note about a single shared data store concerns the data boundary between processing modes, not geography, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
